# Genesis

> AI-powered visual storytelling software for creators and educators.

Genesis (iamazeyou.me) is an AI creative software platform — NOT a spiritual, wellness, religious, or personal development service. It is a SaaS product in the Artificial Intelligence and Creative Tools industry (NAICS 511210 — Software Publishers).

Genesis lets users generate AI illustrations and build visual narratives across three fiction and science-themed creative environments. Instead of starting from a blank canvas, users choose a content theme — The Cosmos (sci-fi and space science), The Kingdom (fantasy fiction), or The Cell (biology and microscience) — and an AI creative assistant named Gen helps generate styled visuals and structured story content.

Genesis is built for writers, educators, content creators, and illustrators who want structured, guided AI image generation without prompt engineering. It is creative production software for visual media, not a mindfulness, spiritual, or self-help product.

Key features and benefits:
- Themed creative realms that provide guided context for AI visual generation
- Gen, an AI creative companion who guides the storytelling journey
- Immersive world-building across science, fantasy, and biology themes
- Visual Studio for hands-on AI image creation and refinement
- Curriculum tools for structured creative learning and exploration
- Accessible to creators of all experience levels - no prompt engineering required

## Creative Realms

Genesis offers three themed creative realms that provide guided context for AI visual generation:

- The Cosmos: Explore galaxies, supernovas, and celestial wonders through AI-generated visuals
- The Kingdom: Knights, dragons, and enchanted realms for fantasy storytelling
- The Cell: Dive into the microscopic universe of life for science-inspired visual creation

## Features

- [Create](https://iamazeyou.me/create): Start generating AI visuals within a chosen realm
- [Visual Studio](https://iamazeyou.me/visual-studio): Advanced workspace for refining and building AI-generated imagery
- [Curriculum](https://iamazeyou.me/curriculum): Structured creative learning paths for guided storytelling development

## Getting Started

- [Start Creating](https://iamazeyou.me): Choose a content theme and generate AI visuals
- [Pricing](https://iamazeyou.me/pricing): Plans and subscription options

## Pricing

- Spark (Free): 3 creations per month, basic features, personal use
- Creator ($19.99/mo): 30 creations, 12 pages each, no watermarks, commercial license
- Studio ($59.99/mo): Unlimited creations, all styles, priority rendering, team access
- Empire ($199.99/mo): Enterprise-grade volume, white-label options, dedicated support

## AI Character Design

Genesis provides AI-driven character design through themed creative realms. Characters maintain consistent appearance, outfit, colour palette, and proportions across every generation. Gen, the AI companion, remembers character details across sessions. Key character design capabilities include:

- Consistent character styling across scenes and poses
- Fantasy character design via The Kingdom realm (knights, dragons, enchanted creatures)
- Sci-fi character concept art via The Cosmos realm (space explorers, alien species)
- Biology-inspired character illustration via The Cell realm
- Over 20 visual styles: watercolour, pixel art, cyberpunk, realistic, corporate, and more
- Rapid iteration in the Visual Studio for refining character details
- No prompt engineering required — guided interface asks clarifying questions
- Game development character concept art, comic character sheets, animation prototyping
- Commercial licensing available on Creator tier and above
